summary: The feature updates most release-facing docs to Neo Zed, but the touched legal pages still identify the service operator as `Zed Industries, Inc.` in the Terms and Privacy Policy, so the legal identity is still upstream-branded and materially inaccurate.

issues.description: The rebranded legal pages still say the service is operated by `Zed Industries, Inc.` in `legal/terms.md:8`, `legal/terms.md:188`, `legal/terms.md:210`, `legal/terms.md:250`, `legal/privacy-policy.md:21`, and `legal/privacy-policy.md:177`. Because these are user-facing legal disclosures, shipping them as-is would misidentify who operates Neo Zed and leave upstream branding in a surface this feature explicitly updated.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the upstream company name and mailing details with the actual fork-owned legal entity information, or clearly mark these pages as placeholders until the correct operator details are available.
